usage: convert_tf_checkpoint_to_torch.py [-h] [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                                         [--output OUTPUT]
                                         [--model-type {pileup,full_alignment}]
                                         [--checkpoint-dir CHECKPOINT_DIR]
                                         [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                         [--pileup-prefix PILEUP_PREFIX]
                                         [--fa-prefix FA_PREFIX]
                                         [--platform {ont,hifi,ilmn}]
                                         [--add-indel-length]
                                         [--pileup-add-indel-length]
                                         [--fa-add-indel-length]
                                         [--enable-dwell-time]

Convert Clair3 TensorFlow checkpoints to PyTorch state_dict

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        TF checkpoint prefix or directory
  --output OUTPUT       Output .pt file path
  --model-type {pileup,full_alignment}
                        Model type to convert
  --checkpoint-dir CHECKPOINT_DIR
                        Directory containing pileup/full_alignment checkpoints
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory for both pileup and full-alignment
                        .pt files
  --pileup-prefix PILEUP_PREFIX
                        Pileup checkpoint prefix name
  --fa-prefix FA_PREFIX
                        Full-alignment checkpoint prefix name
  --platform {ont,hifi,ilmn}
                        Platform
  --add-indel-length    Include indel length heads
  --pileup-add-indel-length
                        Include indel length heads for pileup
  --fa-add-indel-length
                        Include indel length heads for full-alignment
  --enable-dwell-time   Enable dwell time channel (full alignment)
